site.pricing.faq.title: Questions? Answers.
site.pricing.faq.q1: How does the free trial work?
site.pricing.faq.a1: Create your store and use Rentify free for the length of the trial. You don’t need a credit card to start.
site.pricing.faq.q2: What happens when my trial ends?
site.pricing.faq.a2: Choose a plan from your dashboard’s billing settings to keep selling. You can do it at any time during the trial.
site.pricing.faq.a3: Checkout supports KHQR, so customers pay with the banking app they already use. Payments are confirmed automatically.
site.pricing.faq.q4: Can I use my own domain?
site.pricing.faq.a4: Yes. Check the comparison above to see which plans include a custom domain.
site.pricing.faq.a5: Yes. Move to a different plan whenever your business needs it.
site.pricing.faq.a6: Yes. Your storefront works in both Khmer and English, and you can reach our team in either language.
